data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 0.8m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2017. In 2016 there was a reserve release of GBP 1.4m.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small net release of prior year reserves in 2017: overall reserve releases of GBP 0.8m (net of reinsurance). Opening gross claims reserves were GBP 210.466m at 1 January 2017, increasing to a closing gross claims position of GBP 321.768m at 31 December 2017 driven by movements recorded in the technical account and foreign exchange. The net prior year movement was favourable overall, with surplus (releases) in Property, Marine and Credit & Political Risk partly offset by strengthening in Liability (Casualty) and Accident & Health.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 0.8m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2017.
In 2016 there was a reserve release of GBP 1.4m.
The Property, Marine and Credit and Political Risk accounts generated a surplus which was partially offset by a strengthening in the Liability and Accident and Health classes.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year reserve movement (insurance liabilities) was not provided explicitly. The report explicitly states a net prior year release of GBP 0.8m (net of reinsurance) which has been used (flagged as net). Opening gross claims reserves were taken from Technical Provisions note (gross amounts). No gross prior-year-only movement line or gross claims development triangle was available in the extract; therefore gross PYD could not be calculated and net figure was used.
